sentences.text:
Learned ASC for the State, on instructions of IO, informs that pursuant to registration of FIR,
husband and father-in-law of the deceased have already been arrested.
She further informs that investigation is being further taken up in accordance with law and chargesheet shall be filed within the stipulated period.

She also requests that in case there is any particular grievance of the petitioner, the same shall also be further looked into by investigating agency and IO shall ensure that no inconvenience is caused to petitioner, or any member of his family, if they are called for purpose of investigation.
5. In view of the statement made by learned ASC for the State, no further directions are called for at this stage.
Petition is accordingly disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA, J.
